# Brooklin Pub & Grill

> Neighbourhood pub and grill in Brooklin (Whitby), Ontario, Canada, serving pub food, drinks, daily specials and events since 2014.

- Address: 15 Baldwin Street, Brooklin (Whitby), ON L1M 1A2, Canada
- Phone: +1 905-425-3055
- Email: brooklinpub@gmail.com
- Events and private parties: brooklinpubevents@gmail.com
- Opening hours (current hours always on the website): https://brooklinpub.com/contactus

## Pages

- [Home](https://brooklinpub.com/): overview of the pub, specials and upcoming events
- [Menu](https://brooklinpub.com/menu): full food and drinks menu with prices
- [Daily specials](https://brooklinpub.com/special/daily): this week's daily specials
- [Events](https://brooklinpub.com/events): live music and upcoming events
- [Gift cards](https://brooklinpub.com/gift-cards): buy a gift card (never expires, no fees)
- [About](https://brooklinpub.com/about): the pub's story and team
- [Contact](https://brooklinpub.com/contactus): hours, directions, reservations and private event enquiries
